title: dryopteris × tauschii
intro: Dryopteris × tauschii, commonly known as the Tausch's wood fern, is a hybrid species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris × tauschii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents may help to protect against oxidative stress and promote overall well-being.
